desc: The 1911 Hero Custom is a special edition for a critical mission. Each goes above and beyond the attention to detail Kimber is famous for, with military-inspired colors and extras such as custom engraving, fiber optic sights, Kryptek Highlander grips and more. Kimber is a proud business supporter of the Boot Campaign. The Boot Campaign provides programs and initiatives to help veterans and families transition from military life to civilian life.
